baseline.authority: Test/evidence changes only in named paths; current product/configuration/canonical knowledge is read-only. Use reviewed disposable fixtures and approved host execution, never mutate selected live knowledge to make tests pass. No Task, role, memory, source product, Template/root adoption, retirement, Git or external publication writes. Restore any temporary host accessibility/zoom setting after observed checks.
criteria: AT-24, AT-25, AT-26, AT-27 pass with direct old-write requests, hostile scope/credentials, traversal/symlink/oversized files and malicious labels/source links, while protected bytes remain unchanged.
No generic dispatch, optional service invocation, runtime secret leakage, broad CORS, arbitrary source/asset access or cross-project route/session/cache data exists.

AT-01, AT-02, AT-03, AT-04, AT-05, AT-06, AT-07, AT-08, AT-09, AT-10, AT-11, AT-12, AT-13, AT-14, AT-15, AT-16, AT-17, AT-18, AT-19, AT-20, AT-21, AT-22, AT-23, AT-28, AT-29, AT-32, AT-34 each has observed production evidence and exact fixture/build identity.
Installed bundle works without Node server, external assets, embeddings/RDF/inference, profile enablement or Director publication grants; missing assets fail specifically.
AT-29, AT-30, labeled search/combobox behavior, visible unobscured focus, contrast and applicable 24px target exceptions have specific evidence.
Actual browser/AT versions include macOS VoiceOver/Safari; Windows combination is tested when available or its non-exercise is explicit.
A scanner pass is never an unqualified WCAG compliance claim and diagram exception never excuses surrounding text/control reflow.
AT-33 establishes unchanged ontology/source configuration, memory data/config, proposals, publication receipts and generated products across all reads.
Only exact documented startup session/runtime files and harmless preference keys are exempt; no broad .sys4ai exemption exists.
Opening evidence never repairs source hashes and stale/missing wiki never triggers rebuild or blocks definitions.
AT-36 reports repeated-run median and p95, memory, enforced limits and graceful degradation at approximate 50/100, 1000/5000 and 5000/50000 entry/relation targets, with loader capacity measured.
Proposed 2s cold first-read, warm search p95 200ms excluding debounce, entry p95 250ms, 1.5s focused 25/50 graph and 100ms loaded selection remain reported targets; actual misses remain visible.
Additional connections leave the old view usable with bounded progress/cancellation; source validation cost and compressed bundle size are measured separately.
Participant can attempt find/explain term, distinguish terms, interpret relation endpoints/meaning, visit neighbor/return, understand supported or absent process order and inspect freshness.
Record completion, wrong turns, mistaken meanings, requests for help and participant wording; 30s known-term target stays proposed and no statistical generalization is made.
Resolve high-impact reversed-direction or layout-causality misconceptions before claiming usable release; owner-only results state the limitation.
